what: Human support audit of every claim the production prompt drafted in the Vertex eval run (phase A, raw drafts before code validation). Each claim was read against the values and quotes of the facts it cites.
rater: the builder of this system, single rater, no second labeler; treat as indicative, not as ground truth
source_file: eval/results/claim_audit/production_claims.txt (P-numbered claims; the same P section is repeated in all_claims.txt)
rule: unsupported = the sentence asserts something about the account the cited quotes do not say: market position (leading, premier), growth rate (rapid, high-growth), scale or amounts beyond the quote, work model or location not in cited facts, or intent inferred by combining facts. Growth implied by active hiring is supported. The same rule was applied to the loose-prompt audit (loose_labels.json).

stripped_but_supported.why: stripped for 'DIY', which abbreviates the quoted 'Do-it-yourself'

unsupported.claim: hiring for multiple open roles across engineering, GTM, marketing, operations, and product
unsupported.why: the cited quote only says 38 open positions match the current filters; the department list is not in the quote

unsupported.claim: Attio is currently hiring for operations roles in London
unsupported.why: combines an HQ fact and an open-roles fact into a location-specific hiring claim neither quote makes

unsupported.claim: Retool operates in the low-code space
unsupported.why: the quote is about opportunities founders can take in the low-code space, not a statement of Retool's category

unsupported.claim: Airtable is currently hiring for various roles
unsupported.why: the quote is a recruiting tagline (Join Airtable and empower people...), not a statement that roles are open

unsupported.claim: open job opportunities across multiple departments
unsupported.why: the quote says explore job opportunities; multiple departments is not stated

unsupported.claim: Close is an Austin, Texas-based sales CRM platform
unsupported.why: the quote is a mailing address; the same company describes itself as 100% remote (P85)

borderline_counted_as_supported.claim: PostHog is an open source Product OS and AI company
borderline_counted_as_supported.why: the AI company quote is 'There are other AI companies, but they not like us', which implies but does not plainly state it

code_validation_caught: none of the six: each uses only names and numbers present in its cited facts, which is all the code check verifies
